first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: crowd of spectators along the route
entities.identification: A crowd of multiple spectators outside the metal barriers on the left side of the track, separate from the foreground rider; individual people are not tracked across route sections.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The first-person foreground rider, with black-sleeved arms and white gloves bearing red-and-black markings visible, holding the handlebar with both hands.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The mountain bicycle operated by Person B; a black flat handlebar, black front wheel, and red front components are visible in the foreground.

entities.name: track surface
entities.identification: The riding surface closely adjoining the wall on the right, composed of a narrow light-brown platform connected to descending steps.

entities.name: metal barriers along the route
entities.identification: The continuously arranged gray tubular-frame barriers on the left side of the track, with thin rods inside and horizontal connections.

entities.name: wall beside the track
entities.identification: The wall immediately beside the right side of the track, with red-brick, light-gray plastered, and colorful graffiti-covered surfaces visible along the direction of travel.

entities.name: residential buildings along the route
entities.identification: The cluster of buildings composed of the light-yellow low-rise house on the left and the blue house ahead.

entities.name: blue sky
entities.identification: The blue sky above the buildings, with patches of thin pale-white clouds.

entities.name: vegetation along the route
entities.identification: Low green and yellow-green clusters of leaves in the strip of soil on the left side of the narrow track, along with a small amount of grass at the base of the wall.

entities.name: utility poles along the route
entities.identification: Slender upright poles extending into the sky near the houses, with overhead lines connected near their tops.

entities.name: cables along the route
entities.identification: Slender dark overhead lines crossing the sky and the area near the rooftops in the upper part of the image.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: The light-colored car in front of the light-yellow house on the left, with dark windows and part of its body occluded by spectators.

entities.name: strip of bare soil beside the road
entities.identification: The low yellow-brown strip of soil between the left edge of the narrow track and the gray street farther outside.

entities.name: distant blue water surface
entities.identification: The band of dark-blue water visible beyond the distant rooftops and buildings.

entities.name: spectator-held recording device
entities.identification: The collection of small recording devices held up by spectators on the image-left, delimited by their visible outlines, without distinguishing mobile phones from small cameras.

entities.name: hard ground outside the track
entities.identification: The gray street surface occupied by the barriers and spectators, located lower than and to the left of the narrow riding platform.
